phase_policies.applies_when: At around 3 minutes, you have a Reaper and heavy production, while the opponent is still in the early game with no reliable combat units seen. Your economy is heavy but your expansion is uncertain.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have scouted the opponent's expansion or if you see signs of an early attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and expansion while maintaining production and tech; use Reaper for scouting and harassment.
phase_policies.target: Increase economy and expansion, continue producing units and tech, use Reaper for scouting and harassment.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Reaper Pressure and Expansion
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to early pressure without scouting the opponent's defense; avoid delaying expansion or production.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 4 minutes, you have a solid ground army with Siege Tanks, Marines, and Reapers, and your economy and production are heavy. The opponent is likely on a ground-focused macro build with Queens and light tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a clear read on the opponent's tech path or if you detect an incoming attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground army and economy, maintain production and tech, keep defenses ready.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army while increasing economy; maintain production and technology development, keep defenses up.
phase_policies.title: Early-Mid Game Tech and Production Ramp
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single tech path without scouting; avoid neglecting economy or expansion.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 8-9 minutes, you have a strong ground army with Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, and Medivacs. The opponent has a heavy ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens, and heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a clear picture of the Zerg's tech path or if you plan to take a third base.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Consolidate ground army, maintain economy and tech, stay alert for tech switches.
phase_policies.target: Maintain ground army strength and economy, continue teching up, keep defenses solid and be ready to respond to aggression.
phase_policies.title: Mid-Game Ground Army Consolidation
phase_policies.veto: Do not become passive and neglect scouting for tech switches like Mutalisks; avoid overcommitting to ground only.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 10 minutes, you have a strong ground army with Siege Tanks, Marines, Medivacs, and Widow Mines. The opponent has a heavy ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens, and heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a clear read on the Zerg's composition or if you plan to take a fourth base.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Diversify with air and tech, maintain ground strength, expand and keep production.
phase_policies.target: Increase air presence and technology, continue strengthening ground army, expand and keep production going.
phase_policies.title: Late-Mid Game Army and Tech Upgrade
phase_policies.veto: Do not stick purely to ground forces and production, being too passive; avoid neglecting to scout for tech switches.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
